newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Taiwan buys low sulphur Apr fuel oil at $136-139/T.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan buys low sulphur Apr fuel oil at $136-139/T.

text.p: Taiwan's state-owned Chinese Petroleum Corp (CPC) has bought more than one 38,000-tonne cargo of 0.5 percent low sulphur fuel oil for April delivery, a company official said on Monday.

The cargoes, with low pour point at more than $139 per tonne on a cost-and-freight (c-and-f) basis to Keelung or Taichung and high pour point at more than $136 c-and-f Kaohsiung, both for delivery to April 1-15.
A trader said CPC bought a total of six cargoes but the official declined to confirm the number of the cargoes.
In its last tender, CPC bought three 38,000-tonne cargoes of low pour 0.5 percent sulphur fuel oil at around $142.50 per tonne c-and-f for second-half March delivery.
